steps.text: Crack the vault: arrange the digits so the number obeys every rule shown (like the largest possible, or divisible by a number).
Tap a digit to place it — each digit is used once. You decide the order.
Fill all the slots. Tap “Clear” to start the arrangement over.
When your number is ready, tap “Check” to test it against the vault rules.
Think about place value: the leftmost digit matters most for making a number bigger or smaller.

coach.mission: Arrange the digits to satisfy every rule.
whenStuck: Tap digits to place them; “Clear” restarts, “Check” tests.
Start with the rule about the largest place value.
whenWrong: Check each rule one at a time — the leftmost digit sets how big the number is.
Re-read the constraints; one digit is likely in the wrong place value.
coach.done: You've solved the digit vault. Try another arrangement, or move on.

onCorrect: You balanced all the constraints — sharp place-value reasoning.
